title: Cognichip, which is building an AI model for chip design, raised a $60M Series A led by Seligman Ventures, with participation from new board member Lip-Bu Tan (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
summary: Tim Fernholz / TechCrunch: Cognichip, which is building an AI model for chip design, raised a $60M Series A led by Seligman Ventures, with participation from new board member Lip-Bu Tan — The most advanced silicon chips have accelerated the development of artificial intelligence. Now, can AI return the favor?
